// diagnostic E2817

Jet.EnqueueNotOneJobCall

This `app.enqueue` call does not queue one call of an `#App.Job` method of its service: {found}.

What

This `app.enqueue` call does not queue one call of an `#App.Job` method of its service: {found}.

Why

A queued job is stored in its call's transaction as the job's name and its arguments, encoded where `enqueue` is called, and runs after the call commits, again after a failure; only one call of a job method with codable arguments can be stored and run again so.

Fix

Make the closure's whole body one call, `self.method(args)`, in a method of the service, where `method` is marked `#App.Job` and each argument's type derives `Encode` and `Decode`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.EnqueueNotOneJobCall: Tests/UI/web_app_enqueue_not_one_job_call.stderr.
